adjudication.rationale: In `packages/emails/templates/organizer-add-guests-email.ts`, the email payload sets `replyTo` to an array containing the organizer email plus every attendee email: `replyTo: [this.calEvent.organizer.email, ...this.calEvent.attendees.map(({ email }) => email)]`. Since `to` is set to each team member (`toAddresses = [this.teamMember?.email || this.calEvent.organizer.email]`), each team member recipient will receive an email whose Reply-To header exposes the full attendee list, which is a privacy/security leak as described.
